Definition: from G4002 and G2532 and G1182; five and tenth:--fifteenth.
BiblicalUsage: Pentekaidekatos means fifteenth. Luke dates the word of God to John in the fifteenth year of Tiberius Caesar, when Pontius Pilate governed Judaea and Herod was tetrarch of Galilee.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God dates His word by the rulers of this world, and the fifteenth year of an emperor is the year of a prophet in the wilderness.
